# Manufacturing synthetic package notice

This notice covers only `manufacturing-process-cost-0.1.1.sem-package.zip`
(SHA-256 `d5d69ce20ba437bf33b4c77439b256d828b52a0120734e666901faa8e28ded6e`)
and its explicitly listed members in the
[publication manifest](../../docs/releases/manufacturing-method-0.5.3.json).

The package contains original, AI-assisted manufacturing-method definitions and
synthetic test fixtures developed for this repository. It contains no customer
source documents, actual supplier quotations, production models, personal
identifiers or reproduced standards. General engineering patterns are expressed
using synthetic objects and values. Copyright and distribution terms for these
authored assets follow the repository's [MIT license](../../LICENSE).

The repository owner has authorized this GitHub publication of the generic method
and these synthetic assets. This is a separate distribution decision recorded in
the publication manifest. The package's historical rights-evidence and origin
records retain their original bytes and describe the earlier local development
scope; they are not silently rewritten as publication approvals.

The archive remains an immutable transport snapshot of
`semantica.manufacturing.process-cost-loop@0.1.1`. GitHub publication does not
promote the candidate into an industry registry or authorize manufacturing,
commercial quotations, inspection acceptance or product release. Runtime software
and book assets retain their separate existing licenses and governance records.
